result.topic_en: A faint, later archival pencil note, not by Riemann, apparently recording that the fair copy of Riemann's dissertation 'Grundlagen für eine allgemeine Theorie der Functionen einer veränderlichen complexen Größe' was bought by a private person at a Sotheby's auction of the Honeyman Collection, with a reference to American Book Prices Current.
